title: Add a dealer mapping
description: Assign dealers to specific groups, limits, or terminals.
ask: How do I add a dealer mapping?
How do I map a terminal to a group?
How do I assign a dealer to a group?
new terminal id account code custodian
find: Open Admin+ in the left sidebar.
Pick Dealer Mapping, under People and access.
Or press Ctrl + K anywhere and type dealer mapping.
how: Click Add New at the top right of the grid.
Pick the Exchange and enter the Terminal ID. Both are required.
Pick the Group, also required. The list comes from Admin+ > Groups, so add the group there first if it is missing.
Optionally enter the Account Code, Dealer Name and Dealer Code.
Tick Custodian if the dealer is a custodian.
Click Save. The new mapping shows in the grid. If the save fails the form stays open with what you entered.

title: Edit a dealer mapping
description: Assign dealers to specific groups, limits, or terminals.
ask: How do I edit a dealer mapping?
How do I change a dealer's group?
How do I change the terminal id of a dealer?
update modify dealer name dealer code custodian
find: Open Admin+ in the left sidebar.
Pick Dealer Mapping, under People and access.
Or press Ctrl + K anywhere and type dealer mapping.
how: Double click the mapping's row. Its cells open for editing.
Change the Terminal ID, Account Code, Group, Dealer Name, Dealer Code or Custodian. The Exchange cannot be changed; delete the mapping and add it again instead.
Press Enter to save, or Esc to cancel.

title: Delete a dealer mapping
description: Assign dealers to specific groups, limits, or terminals.
ask: How do I delete a dealer mapping?
How do I remove a terminal mapping?
remove unmap dealer terminal
find: Open Admin+ in the left sidebar.
Pick Dealer Mapping, under People and access.
Or press Ctrl + K anywhere and type dealer mapping.
how: Click the bin icon at the end of the mapping's row.
Type the row's Terminal ID in the box to confirm.
Click Confirm Delete. This cannot be undone.

title: Upload dealer mappings from a file
description: Assign dealers to specific groups, limits, or terminals.
ask: How do I upload dealer mappings?
How do I add many dealer mappings at once?
import bulk csv file sample
find: Open Admin+ in the left sidebar.
Pick Dealer Mapping, under People and access.
Or press Ctrl + K anywhere and type dealer mapping.
how: Click Upload Mappings at the top right of the grid. The import form opens over the grid, set to dealer mappings.
Download the sample file in the form to see the columns it expects.
Fill it in, pick it and upload.

title: Add a product mapping
description: Link market instruments to internal risk product categories.
ask: How do I add a product mapping?
How do I add a symbol?
How do I set the lot size of a new symbol?
new qlot unit multiplier currency instrument
find: Open Admin+ in the left sidebar.
Pick Product Mapping, under Market data and mapping.
Or press Ctrl + K anywhere and type product mapping.
how: Click Add New at the top right of the grid.
Pick the Exchange and enter the Symbol.
Enter QLot and Multiplier, each 1 or more.
Pick the Unit and the Currency.
Untick Close after save to keep the form open for the next one.
Click Save. The new mapping shows in the grid.
